title: Discovering Your Kingdom Leadership
paragraphs: We will talk about the topic of discovering your personal leadership role in the Kingdom of God. Please take note of these observations. I will give you some points to jot down quickly. First, I would like to welcome all our friends who are joining us via television from all over the world. Wherever you are, in any country, city or hotel, we are happy to have you with us. God bless you, and thank you very much for joining us for our program today from the Diplomatic Centre in Nassau, Bahamas.

I would like to start with some phrases that you can write down, please. The first statement is that God's original plan was to expand His heavenly kingdom on earth. This was God's original plan to expand His heavenly kingdom on earth. This was God's motivation from the beginning. But God has set a plan to achieve that. God wanted to establish a kingdom in the visible world without descending to this world himself.

To achieve this, his plan was to create from his spirit offspring that would be exactly like him, and would serve as his representatives in the visible world. They will launch, establish, and implement His invisible kingdom in the visible world. This has been God's plan from the beginning. The Bible is not a difficult book to understand. God's plan was never to establish a religion. In fact, religion is man-made. The word "religion" is derived from a root meaning search.

Therefore, religion is only necessary for those who have gone astray. Before the fall of man, there was no need for religion. Therefore, every activity that a person undertakes in their quest to find God, whether it be Buddhism, Islam, Confucianism, Hinduism, Shintoism, Baha'i, Rastafarianism, Scientology, Monotheism, or Atheism, is a religion because they are all attempts by a person to search for something they believe they have lost. Isn't it amazing that God solved the problem himself?

Instead of allowing man to spend the rest of his eternal frustration trying to find it, God made a decision. His decision was: "I'll make it easy for you. I'll come and discover you." Therefore, God's plan was never to create a religion. Religion is like an organized club created by man to satisfy his hunger to find God. We call it by different names. I was religious in the past. I am not religious now. Because I no longer search. Is anyone here in this situation? Welcome.

Religious people have not yet found what they are looking for. What I have now is a relationship with the person I abandoned and gave up on. It was never God's will, write this down, that we should have subjects, but sons. This is a very important statement. It was never God's will that we should have subjects, but children. The reason this phrase is difficult is that whenever we hear the word " king," the word "subjects" comes to mind. This is not God's will for us. God is the king, but he doesn't want subjects.

Third, it was never God’s will that we should have Christians, but citizens. God has always wanted citizens as children in His kingdom. What we did was become something we made ourselves. In fact, we have been stigmatized by pagans. The word "Christian" first appeared in the First Epistle to the Corinthians, introduced by pagans. The pagans gave this name to the believers. And now we have accepted this pagan description and are playing their game. I was a Christian.

But today, by God, I am a son, a citizen, and an ambassador. I like this. The Bible says we are ambassadors for Christ and Heaven. We are called by this name, but it does not call us Christians. The Bible says: "To everyone who believes in him, he gives the authority to become what? Children." The Bible calls us children, but it does not call us Christians. The Bible says: "Our citizenship is in heaven." The Bible does not call us Christians, but it calls us citizens.

To be a Christian, you must meet the expectations of the pagans. To be a son, you have to be like your father. To be a citizen, you must represent your country. To be an ambassador, you must represent your government. But to be a Christian, you must meet the standards of the pagans who gave you that title. That's why most sinners will say to you, "I thought you were a Christian." Because they have their own conception of what it means to be a Christian. Because they gave you that nickname.

Tell your neighbor, while he is speaking to you. Tell your neighbor: "Today I release myself from the burden of being a Christian. I will be a son." Clap your hands and thank God. Have you survived now? Yes, you survived. God’s purpose and goal from the beginning was to expand and establish His kingdom on this earth. His simple strategy was to rule the visible world from the invisible world through the invisible human being who inhabits the visible body. Can you write that?

This is perhaps the most important statement I have ever made in my life, because it is the essence of God's program in the Bible. Let me repeat it: God’s original purpose and goal was to rule the visible world, that is, the apparent world, through the invisible world, that is, the spiritual human being who dwells in the visible world, that is, the apparent body, that is, the earth. God wanted to rule the visible world through the invisible world that dwells in the visible world. Do you understand?

So, how will he do that? Well, the invisible God will put His spirit into the invisible world that dwells in the visible world. He communicates from the unseen to the unseen, dwelling in the visible, on the scene, until the visible understands what God wants. Everything God wants is related to the unseen manifested in the visible, and thus the earth shows what heaven is thinking. This is God's plan. It still is, and it always will be.

So, what we really have is the King of the universe and the unseen world, Elohim, Jehovah Yerah, Adonai, Jehovah Rapha, Jehovah Shamah, all the names you want to call Him by, Almighty God. You get the invisible king, and the king is " King". It means the ruler or the one who sets the standards. The one who sets the standards for everything is the King, the ruler of the unseen world, the owner of the visible world, and the one who dwells in the unseen. He is the Almighty, invisible God. He is the king.

Everyone says "king". I repeat myself for a reason. What is it? He owns everything. He is the king, he is the standard-setter, he is the rule-setter, he is the judge of everything. He is the king. You cannot be a king unless there is something to rule. In other words, you can't rule over nothing. Do you understand what I mean? To be a king, you must have something to rule, something to set standards for. Therefore, what God did, above all, was only God, because everything that exists was created by God.

There was a time when God was not a king, because there was nothing for him to rule. He was God alone. Elohim, three in one, alone, standing on nothing in a corner of nothingness. This god, by his very nature, could do nothing but do so. Because the first word that identifies Him in the Bible, the first word that describes Him, is this word: Creator. God does not create. He is the Creator. Therefore, creation is a natural consequence of being a creator. Therefore, God created because He is the Creator.

He was not created to become a creator. He created because He was already the Creator. Creation, creation, and innovation were his natural expression. And so, God created everything. First, the invisible world, then the visible world. And so, what did it automatically become? A king. Because what does he own now? شيئًا يحكمه. What the king rules is called his kingdom. Everyone says kingdom. Write the word. So, you have a king, but what do you have? kingdom. You cannot be a king without a kingdom.

You cannot be a president without a country. You cannot be a prime minister without a nation. So, you need something to control. Incidentally, this is the reason for Lucifer's problem. لأنه لا يملك شيئًا. تحدثوا معي يا رفاق. Therefore, he can never be a king. That is why Satan is not mentioned anywhere in the Bible as a king. He is simply an unemployed Krupp. Therefore, if the devil is ruling your life, that is illegal.

If the devil controls your money, your body, your family, your home, or your neighborhood, then the devil is illegal. As you know, it is amazing that God created His kingdom. So, what do we have now? لدينا ملكٌ وملكوته. فلنقل جميعًا: ملك. kingdom. فلنقل: مملكة. قلها بسرعة. faster. faster. You're good at that, aren't you? The inevitable result of having a king and a kingdom is a kingdom. This is the crux of the matter. إنه يتعلق بالمملكة. Simply put, the relationship between the king and his kingdom.

The kingdom includes what is visible and what is invisible. The Bible says that everything was created through him, and without him nothing was created. Therefore, everything that exists is what He made, He created, and therefore it truly belongs to Him, and therefore it is His kingdom. إذن، هو ملك كل الممالك. It is his kingdom. This is the essence of the whole Bible, the Kingdom. Now, if you wish, look at Genesis, chapter one, verse 26. The Bible says: “Let us make man in our image and likeness. Let him have what?

And let him serve what? The fish of the sea and the birds of the air.” Do we need to say this now? Do we need it? Okay, can we wait a little longer? Yes. What does God's word say He created you for? In his image and likeness, so that you may have what? Sovereignty. لماذا خلقك الله؟ Say it out loud. Do you see worship in this verse? Do you see any chanting in this verse? Oh. What about this? Do you see Paradise in this verse? لم تُخلق من أجل الجنة. This is where I came from.

God did not need another rose in his garden. هل سمعت هذا من قبل؟ In fact, we say that God kills people because he needs another rose in his garden. ليس لدى الله حديقة. ليس لدى الله جنة. There is no god who wants people to be in heaven. God's purpose in creating man was very clear. God said, "Look, I needed someone to take control of a place called Earth." This is what I needed. I didn't need anyone in heaven to sing for me. لديّ بعض الملائكة. إنهم أفضل بكثير منكم. لست بحاجة إلى سماع جوقة. أحتاج إلى من يحكمني.

Tell your neighbor, "Things aren't looking good. You were created to be in charge of the Earth. So, He said, 'He created man.' Why? To have dominion over what? The fish, the birds—read it there. The cattle, the plants, and everything on Earth. So, God's plan was to create a creature with dominion or rule over a domain called Earth. This is obvious to God. Not quite so obvious to us yet, but obvious to God.

Therefore, God is very committed to what He does, and every human being was created, consequently, to have dominion over this planet. So, the spirit of dominion and the mandate of dominion are locked in each of you. That's why you go crazy when it takes control of you. The Bible says you have to have dominion over the plants, the birds, all creatures, the animals, and everything on Earth. Can you imagine a human being who is supposed to have dominion over a plant, and then a plant takes control of him?

A tobacco leaf? A coconut leaf? A grape juice? How dare you claim to be a muscular man with armpit hair, when a Colombian leaf runs your life? I'm not impressed by your dignified gait in your shoes." You in your high heels and designer handbag, while a leaf from Cuba runs your life.

I admire your formal appearance in your opulent ten-story office, how you park your car in the back garage and take the elevator, but when you arrive at your grand mahogany desk, you find a small bottle on the shelf that runs your life, and at eleven o'clock it calls to you, "Come drink me now," and you bow before it. Can you imagine that your life's tree runs? I now doubt that any of you here run your lives with grape juice. Your lives are not run by leaves from Cuba or plants from Colombia.

I don't think you are any more dignified than that. Your lives are run by a far more refined tree. Look, the saints have another problem with Bush. I once heard a lady giving her testimony in church here in the Bahamas, and she said, " He woke me up this morning." He began my journey, and put my feet on a rock to stand on, and I want to pray to draw my strength from the Lord. Pray for me. Amen. "Then the Holy Spirit said to me, 'She is lying.'" هذا ما أيقظها هذا الصباح. "That's what set her on the right path.

Look, because the Lord said, you know, when it was a prayer meeting and it was raining, she didn't go. But, when it was raining and it was time to go to work, she got up in the rain. Well, it's cold tonight, you know. I can't attend the prayer meeting, but no matter how cold it is, when it's time to go get things, I feel in control of what I'm supposed to control.

No wonder, then, that the first thing that happened in the early church, as it's written in the Book of Acts, at their first meeting, was that people came and bought this thing and threw it on the ground and put it under the apostles' feet. Why? Because this thing had previously ruled them. Now they would rule it. You know, you're not supposed to work for money. Money is supposed to work for you. When you work for money, you'll be poor and you'll stay poor.

People who understand the value of money don't work for it; they let money work for them. If you chase money, money will keep running away. But if you send money somewhere, it will come back to you. That's a fact. So, God gave humankind sovereignty over all these things and made them the masters of the earth. The word "dominion" means rule, administration, control, command, leadership, and authority. God gave humankind all these wonderful qualities. Then humankind committed a folly.

Now, let me tell you something, my friends. God never gave us ownership; He gave us sovereignty. Mark my words. When someone gives you ownership, you know they are no longer responsible. But if they give you sovereignty, they remain responsible. That's why God set conditions. He said, " If you obey me and don't touch that tree, you can manage this planet as you wish and for as long as you want." It is yours. So, what God has given to man is what I call the contract for managing the earth. لقد أعطاه اتفاقية إيجار.

الكتاب المقدس واضح جدًا. He says that the earth and everything on it still belongs to God. لم تكن ملكًا لكم أبدًا. He gave it to you to manage under a lease agreement called a sovereign delegation. Therefore, whatever you do to the planet, you must account to the owner. How you use the planet and what you do with it, you must report, and we will be held accountable according to how we agreed to manage the planet. Open with me, if you wish, to the verse that I keep referring to.

It is found in the Book of Psalms, Psalm 115. Open them all quickly, please. Tell your neighbor: I was born to rule this place. "As you know, when you feel controlled by the earth, you will suffer from high blood pressure and health problems, because you were not created to be controlled by this earth. Your body rebels against it. Even your physical body becomes ill when it is under the pressure of this earth. Look at Psalm 150. Young people, please underline this verse.

This psalm changed my life during my teenage years. I have never forgotten reading it; it completely changed my view of myself and of this planet. Here is what it says in verse 14: 'May the Lord your God multiply you and your descendants, and may the Lord bless you.' Creator of what?" السماوات والأرض. "Now, the next verse is fascinating. It says, 'the highest heavens.' This means that 'highest' refers to those above the stratosphere and the Earth's hemisphere. We are talking about the unseen realm where God dwells.

It says, 'To whom do the highest heavens belong?'" “To the Lord. But to whom did he give the earth? To man. Now, the Bible tells you, as you know, directly: “ See, heaven is not for you. I will fly away.” God says, “Where are you going?” “I don’t want you here. This isn’t your land. Let me tell you something. God has made arrangements to ensure you never stay in heaven. Because if you stay in heaven, God’s word will fail.

The Bible says, ‘As the dew falls, and as the rain falls, so my word goes out of my mouth and returns without accomplishing that for which I was sent.’” In other words, if God says He created you to rule the Earth, it's perfectly clear you won't stay in Paradise. If you stay, He has broken His promise. What is His purpose in creating you? It's very clear. We won't speculate on this; it's to rule the Earth. This is God's promise to you. His purpose in creating you is to rule and control the Earth.

He has no doubt about it. Therefore, what we created is the religion of Paradise, and God has a mandate over the Earth. Everyone wants to go to Paradise, and God doesn't want anyone there. So, He made arrangements. God made arrangements to ensure that everyone who dies now will leave Paradise and return. Therefore, He made arrangements for your bodies. This is what is called the Resurrection. God says the Earth belongs to you. He gave it to us.

This means we are the managers, the overseers, the rulers, and the leaders of this planet. And everything that happens to this planet is our responsibility. That's why God says He can't lose anything here. Or that you can't tie anything here because He is not the one in charge here. He says: What you tie on Earth, you can't tie in Heaven. That's not your business. He said: What you tie on Earth is What? It's tied to heaven. What you do on earth, heaven does.

In other words, heaven can't do anything on earth without permission or authorization from those whom God has empowered. So, if something doesn't happen on earth, it's because we don't allow it to happen. Is that clear? That's why so many people say to me, " Pastor Miles, if God is sovereign and can do whatever He wants, why do we pray?" " That is, if you pray and God will do whatever He wills, then you're better off not wasting your time praying.

No, you see, if you don't understand the system of the earth, you won't understand prayer. Prayer is giving God permission to continually intervene in the earth because you are the one who has that permission. God is all-powerful, but He only releases what you allow. Does anyone agree with me? Do you understand what I've just said? That's why Jesus said, 'Listen to my words.' Jesus, you know, is speaking to the disciples now. He says, ' You know, you don't understand.' He says, 'People must always pray.'

Now, listen to these words, 'must.' In other words, 'must' means you're all stupid. You all do n't understand that if you don't do this thing, nothing will happen. He says, ' People must always...' Who is he speaking? The one who made this system. People must always pray and never stop. You're not supposed to go to a prayer meeting, my friend. You're supposed to be... one. Kush and Raba Kastatha.

In the car, at the gas station, in The grocery store, the bedroom, the bathroom, the backyard, the office, the construction site, the plumbing. God says: You'd better keep praying if you want me to keep intervening. John Wesley put it this way: " Prayer is strange." It seems as if we cannot do without God. I am not us, and God will not be. " We're stuck. So, if you don't like the situation on Earth, start planning through prayer. Anyone agree? Prayer isn't just spirituality. Prayer is action. Hello?

You're dealing with a government; you're its ambassador. And prayer is the channel through which the facts reach you. Prayer is how you get the flow of information and resources from the government, and God's hidden government has access to you through your faith to influence the Earth through the authority He has given you, so that you can influence it from behind the scenes. You can transform your week this week by understanding prayer. Everything Jesus did was about the Kingdom.

He understood the meaning of sovereignty. That's why He gave the Earth to man. My friends, man's fall corrupted everything. Man's fall wasn't from Heaven, but from sovereignty. Write this down. Man didn't fall from Heaven. Didn't he? Read your Bible. We did n't fall from Heaven. So when we say ' fall,' we keep thinking that we fell from Heaven. It's important to understand this. Man didn't fall from Heaven. The record Moses wrote is very clear. Man fell from his responsibility of sovereignty over the Earth.

Satan didn't say, ' Eve, if you pluck the fruit, you will fall from heaven.” But she said, “If you pluck the fruit, you will be like God.” A foolish request. They were already like God. By the way, the greatest weapon against anyone is self-doubt. I’ll repeat that again because it’s a bit heavy. The greatest weapon you can use against someone is to make them doubt themselves. Self-doubt involves low self-esteem, low self-concept, self-misunderstanding, low self-worth, and low self-esteem because you doubt yourself.

When someone doubts themselves, they think they can’t do what they’re capable of. The devil planted what I call the idea of self-hatred. That’s why this ministry is so important. Our mission in the world is very clear. Let me tell you what our mission is. Our mission is to take a follower and make them think like a leader. Why? Because they are. But their upbringing from their past, their culture, and their environment has made them think they are n’t what they are.

No member of this church should accept a job without having the understanding that when this is over, I will be in charge. Don’t go and listen, I won’t forget. Never mind the meeting I attended when I was in Malaysia. I went to Sony, and I was sitting and talking with a group of millionaires, about seven or eight men, all millionaires. We were chatting, and they were very happy to meet me, you know, because I was from the Bahamas, and I have a nice complexion, and they were excited that I was there in Malaysia.

While we were eating, I took a break from the seminar, and one of them said to me, "Do you know how I made my money?" "وروى لي قصة. فقلت:" رائع! He said, " By the way, tell me, why is it that people of your skin color make money in any country we go to, but when we go there we don't make it?" It seems that none of you are achieving the desired success. "فقلت:" لا أعرف، أخبرني. He said: "I finally discovered it when I went to America." There was a man from China working in Malaysia as a consultant for Sony.

He said: When I went to America, I noticed that in all the cities I visited... every time an Asian came to the city, he owned nothing. But within a few months, he owns a business. He says, "Your people with the beautiful skin have been here for a thousand years. They own nothing. Keep searching, keep listening to me. Keep listening to me. They own nothing." He says, "I tried to understand. He says, "Because I know that you are all hardworking people."

He says: "After studying this matter for 5 or 6 years, I finally understood." He says: "As you know, when I spoke to your people, I finally understood that we have different mindsets. Not abilities, but different mindsets." He says: "The difference between us is that when we go to a city, we think differently." He says: " For example, when you go to any city, you look for a job. He says: "The Chinese never look for jobs." He says: "When we go to a city, we look for a business project."

He said: " Even if we get a job, that's not what we're looking for." We only hold onto the job until we get the work. "That's a good way of thinking. I think you need to realize the truth. Look, it all boils down to what? The Kingdom mindset. If you think you have to follow everything all the time, then follow. And believe me, there are enough people in the world to lead you. I decided years ago in Vine Town, at the age of fourteen, I decided, um, to rule Britain, to rule Britain, not to rule this Britain.

I decided years ago that no queen was born to rule, no one was born to rule me. No one was born to rule Miles. You weren't born, you can't be born good enough to rule these good things. You don't have what it takes. Only God can rule this. Oh, I feel myself this morning. Look, the devil said to Eve, ' You are not like God.'" " I came to you this morning to tell you, and to tell you watching the television program, that you are like God.

God did not create you in the image of a dog or a monkey or a chimpanzee or any of those evolutionary ideas. He created you in His own image. That's why I don't understand people saying, 'You have a rich church.' We only have a rich word. When the word reaches us, we put on fine clothes. Welcome. Even if we were at rock bottom and came here, we start looking up, rising, and striving for better. Why? Because suddenly we realize who we are. We are like our Father, God. I used to be a bohemian.

I had to break free from my country. I'm not a bohemian in the first place. I've been freed. I am a child of God first, and I just happen to live in the Bahamas, and God has blessed me to be laid to rest on this little rock. And look what I'm doing with this rock—making it look a little better. Come on, praise the Lord, you who love. You who love. You are not closed off." For yourselves. You are children of God, and you have a gift that will bless the Bahamas. Praise the Lord once more. You are the ones who love.

Hallelujah, my brother. Don't go to work tomorrow with your head down and your shoulders slumped. I want you to walk the rest of your life saying, "Good morning, everyone." ابني وصل للتو. Father in heaven, does anyone need help? "Come, praise Him, you who love Him. Say Amen. Amen means a lot to me. My son, God said, 'My kingdom is yours.' He gave us His kingdom on earth. What a great responsibility! So, no plant should control your life. If you smoke cigarettes, stop now. Don't let a leaf run your life, man. Don't.

And you young people, don't let anyone encourage you to make the cocoa leaf your master. In fact, you don't have to resist drugs. It's beneath you. It should be. It's beneath you. You're supposed to be in control of it. Paul says, 'I will not be subject to anything.' I've seen people who lived good lives, and then they started drinking. They call it being social. They started smoking. They call it peer pressure. They started doing drugs. They call it immersion. What a tragedy!

And then there are those who are controlled by sex. Lust. And some of you are still struggling with it? How?" How can an industry control you when you're supposed to rule the world? Some people are controlled by their genitals. It's shameful. Silence. Take control. Be king. Even king of your genitals. Oh, this is a good place to say Amen. You've all been wrong. If someone says, "Let's go to bed," and you're not married, say, "Just a moment, please." I can't go to bed. Why? I am a king. What? I am a king.

So, what does that have to do with going to bed? Well, I'm in control of everything. What do you mean? I control my underwear. And in my pants. انظر إليّ باستغراب. يا إلهي، القس شيء آخر. الآن، أنا لست كذلك. We need to speak frankly with these young people as well. ومع كبار السن. I know that no member of this church comes here. I know that. I am talking about other people in other churches. No member of this church comes here and says, "I love you, Lord." "And they're having sex with others.

I know that wo n't happen. I know there's no homosexuality here. I assure you there are no homosexuals here. I know that. I'm sure of it. There's no doubt about it. Because we have kings here. Is the Lord talking to you? Fix it. We're kings, man. Sovereignty. You know, I was thinking about this fall the other day. And the Lord said this to me, and I wrote this down. He says, 'Adam didn't lose heaven, but he lost a kingdom on earth.'

God said to me, 'He committed a great betrayal and lost control of his responsibilities to rule on earth.' That's what Adam did. Adam surrendered the administration of the earth to Satan. Adam gave up his throne and made all humans slaves to Satan. He who was supposed to have authority became a slave. He who was supposed to be a ruler became ruled. He who was supposed to be a victor became a victim. He who was supposed to be a king became a subject.

So, when man disobeyed God's command, he not only lost his children but also lost a kingdom on earth. God lost both. That's why when Jesus, God incarnate, came and tried to explain to us what had happened. He had to use a story we could understand. He said that there was a father who had two sons. One of them decided to go his own way, taking what he wanted and leaving. He ended up in a pigsty, eating pig food. One day, he came to his senses and said, "My father is a king, and he has servants."

I will go back to my father and ask him. I know I have sinned, so make me his slave. "At least I'll eat well and be at home. But let me be a servant." Is n't this amazing? قصة يسوع صحيحة تمامًا. He says, "When he came, as soon as he saw him on the road, even though he hadn't reached home yet, the father ran out, caught him, kissed him, and said, 'My lost son is found!' Before the son could explain where he had been, that's how God treats us all.

He does n't want to hear about who you sleep with, what you drink, what you smoke, anything. He said, 'Look, I'm so happy you're back, back, back, back!'" I am very happy that you have returned home." He said: "Slaughter the fattened calf, bring the ring, bring the robe, bring the shoes." Let's celebrate. " Let's celebrate," he said. "Let's dance." What? My lost son.” God is overjoyed that His son has returned home. The problem is that we accepted the contract the son wanted, not the one the father gave him.

We want to be servants of the Lord; that is what it means to be a Christian, a servant of the Lord. Christ says, “I no longer call you slaves, but what are you?” Friends. Why? Because we are a family. You know, Christ is your Savior by circumstance, but he is your brother by blood. It's a big deal. We understand him and admire him, and we embrace him more as Savior than as an older brother. He is our older brother. You were created in his image, and he is the firstborn of the Father.

He is the original model, and we are all created in his image. So, he is our older brother. That's why, in Hebrews, chapter 1, or rather chapter 2, he says that even the Son sees no problem in calling us brothers, because we are a family. That boy wanted to be less than a family; he wanted to be a servant. His mentality was still damaged in the pigsty. He came from an environment where he couldn't believe he could ever be a son again.

I came to proclaim the news to each of the six billion people watching and listening, wherever you are, that you are children. Yes. You know, even if you go astray, you are still my children. Going astray doesn't negate that. And so it is with Every human being. That's why the good news of the kingdom is good news. It's good news because it's a message from the Father to all His children, telling them they can return to the kingdom and be children again in their full right.
